name: Socialwire Article Generator
author: socialwire

sections.description:
Socialwire Article Generator is a WordPress plugin that uses AI to automatically generate articles from press releases. Once configured, it fetches the latest press releases every 30 minutes and creates articles in your preferred writing style.

Key Features

  • Automatic article generation from press releases
  • Customizable writing style for your media
  • Automatic categorization based on content
  • Fully automated after setup – no maintenance required
  • Option to save as draft or auto-publish
  • Completely free with unlimited article generation

Features

  • Full Automation: Generates articles every 30 minutes automatically
  • Easy Setup: Complete setup in 5 minutes
  • Highly Customizable: Configure target genres, writing styles, categories, languages, authors, and publication status
  • Wide Genre Support: IT/Technology, Business, Lifestyle, Entertainment, and more
  • Intuitive Admin Interface: User-friendly management interface

Usage

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings → Socialwire Article Generator for initial configuration
  3. Articles will be automatically generated every 30 minutes

Privacy and Data Collection

Socialwire Article Generator collects and processes the following data:

Data Collected:
* RSS feed data from press releases (publicly available information only)
* Plugin configuration settings (target genres, writing styles, category settings, etc.)
* Generated article data and metadata
* Environment-specific identifier (for site identification, non-personally identifiable)
* Manual editing and deletion status of articles (for duplicate prevention)
* Image processing settings and resize information

External Service Connections:
* Connects to pcn-api.cowriter.jp API server for AI article generation
* External communication occurs for RSS retrieval, article generation, and URL notifications
* All connections are encrypted and conducted via HTTPS
* By activating and configuring this plugin, you consent to these service connections

Data Storage Location:
* WordPress database options and post meta tables
* Temporary lock information uses WordPress transient functionality
* Image files are stored in WordPress media library

Data Usage Purpose:
* Automatic article generation from press releases
* Duplicate article prevention and quality control
* Service functionality provision and improvement
* Technical support provision

User Rights and Data Protection:
* Collected data is used solely for plugin functionality
* No unauthorized disclosure or sale to third parties
* No tracking or analytics without explicit user consent
* All related data is automatically deleted upon plugin removal

30-Minute Interval Automatic Processing:
This plugin automatically performs RSS retrieval and article generation every 30 minutes. These processes are fully automated and do not track user browsing behavior or personal information.

For detailed privacy policy, visit our official site (https://gas.cowriter.jp/privacy/).
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Socialwire Article Generator”
  3. Click “Install Now”
  4. Click “Activate” after installation

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin files
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin in your WordPress admin
  3. Upload the downloaded ZIP file
  4. Click “Activate”

Initial Setup

  1. Go to Settings → Socialwire Article Generator
  2. Specify target genres
  3. Set article writing style
  4. Choose publication categories
  5. Select output language
  6. Choose article author
  7. Set publication status (draft or published)
  8. Save settings
sections.faq:
Is Socialwire Article Generator free?

Yes, Socialwire Article Generator is completely free to use with no hidden costs or limitations.

What genres are supported?

IT/Technology, Business, Lifestyle, Entertainment, and many other genres are supported.

What is the quality of generated articles?

AI technology generates natural, human-like text. Articles can be edited and adjusted as needed.

Which WordPress versions are supported?

WordPress 5.0 and later versions are supported. We recommend using the latest version.

Who owns the copyright of generated articles?

The copyright of generated articles belongs to the site operator. You can use them with confidence.

Can I get support?

You can receive support through the contact form on our official site (https://gas.cowriter.jp/). 24-hour AI chat support is also available.
